prallen.et: From Middle High German prellen (“to bash, bruise”), which see. Compare Middle Low German prallen, prellen, brallen (“to collide, bump, crash”), whence German Low German prallen.

Praliné.et: Derived from French praliné, past participle of praliner (“to coat”).

Praller.et: Either prallen + -er or a clipping of Pralltriller.
